paper_level_summary_zh: 该文在相关工作中简要提及了目标论文，将其归为基于RFID的窃听方法之一，但未详细描述其方法或能力。

evidences.evidence_quote: Akin to WiFi works, RFID [15] and Doppler radar [19] have been leveraged for eavesdropping. In particular, [15] requires a pre-installed tag in the victim's room.
evidences.evidence_context: Akin to WiFi works, RFID [15] and Doppler radar [19] have been leveraged for eavesdropping. In particular, [15] requires a pre-installed tag in the victim's room.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 原文引用标记为[15]，而非目标标记[23]，属于误引。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 该文使用[15]引用目标论文，但目标论文在参考文献中标记为[23]，因此该引用为误引。

evidences.evidence_quote: [23] proposed a speech eavesdropping approach by leveraging the piezoelectric films and mmWave signals.
evidences.evidence_context: Authors in [17] used mmWave to acquire high-quality voice from user's vocal vibrations from near-throat region. [23] proposed a speech eavesdropping approach by leveraging the piezoelectric films and mmWave signals.
evidences.reference_entry: C. Wang et al., "Thru-the-wall Eavesdropping on Loudspeakers via RFID by Capturing Sub-mm Level Vibration," Proc. ACM Interact. Mob. Wearable Ubiquitous Technol., vol. 5, no. 4, pp. 1-25, 2021.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 该句引用[23]描述‘a speech eavesdropping approach by leveraging the piezoelectric films and mmWave signals’，但目标论文实际是RFID亚毫米级振动窃听，非压电薄膜和mmWave信号，描述与目标论文不符，属于误引。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 该文声称[23]提出了一种利用压电薄膜和mmWave信号的语音窃听方法，但目标论文实际利用RFID感知亚毫米级振动，因此该引用不准确。

speakers via mmWave-characterized piezoelectric effect,” in Proc.
